title: 知能情報プログラミングⅢ
subtitle: Intelligent Information Programming III
educationalGoal: In this course, student learn basic Java programming. Specifically, it contains the followings: understanding the basic of Java that requires compiling and static typing variables, writing simple programs, and how to execute Java programs.
advice: Students learn basic of programming with compiling and static typing variables, by using Java with comparing with Python. Contents of Java: (1) The basic of writing Java program and executing programs (2) Concept of variables with typing (3) The grammar of Java and typical programming method for Java
requiredKnowledge: The precedent courses: Intelligent Information Programming I, II - Students have to bring own laptop computer, AC adopter, and network cable for software installation, download of course materials, and upload of answer of quizzes - PC operation skills (such as touch typing, file operation, etc.) are necessary to write program smoothly

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain necessary operations step by step to execute Java programs
Be able to write Java programs using typing of variables appropriately
Be able to write Java programs with conditional branches appropriately
Be able to write Java programs with loops appropriately
Be able to write Java programs using arrays appropriately
Be able to write Java programs using methods appropriately
